claims.statement: Agent-authored method episode: The prior recorded DTR preflight deferral was followed by the explicit alternative selection of a disposable read-only repository runner. Actual runs 46009940905 and 46010254201 completed the same proposal checks and clean-source build/retrieval before further claims; reviewed knowledge was integrated through normal review. Subsequent exact-source combined build, assumption contrast and actual re-entry runs 46010760344, 46011741480 and 46012052796 reused the isolated execution route. This is attributable recorded procedure and actual gate completion, not a controlled comparison or independent learning result.

attributes.decision: Before deferring an actual repository responsibility whose required canonical mechanical gate cannot execute in the active environment, should the agent investigate a bounded authorized equivalent execution context or retain the blocker and select independently warranted work?
attributes.procedure_before: The earlier recorded DTR selections identified the unavailable local CLI and GitHub DNS as a mechanical preflight blocker, separated the blocked gate from independently warranted construction, retained the draft outside active knowledge and deferred promotion until a compatible checkout. Do not infer the agent's unrecorded private reasoning from these records.
attributes.procedure_after: When the unavailable active execution context is a decision-changing constraint, identify the gate's required source, bytes, tool behavior, environment, authority and evidence before deferring the responsibility. Compare an available authorized isolated equivalent execution context with retaining the blocker, including cost and risk. If equivalent for the narrow claim, execute the same gate against exact source and checked bytes, inspect actual returned evidence, and re-warrant the action without bypassing the gate. Otherwise preserve the blocker and continue only independently warranted work.
attributes.scope: Consequential repository-answerable selection when a specific required mechanical gate is unavailable in the active host, under a bounded authorized execution envelope. Not a general recommendation to move work to cloud CI.
attributes.counterevidence: The original local environment may be required for host-native loading, OS-specific behavior, source fingerprints affected by filters or line endings, independent agent attribution, matched experiments or private data. Equivalent Git identity alone does not establish all behavioral equivalence. A compatible local checkout or manual source recovery may be cheaper. Earlier conditional construction-versus-qualification guidance already calls for actual feasibility checks; this may be a useful specialization rather than a distinct learned method.
attributes.claim_ceiling: One same-agent source-attributed before/after selection comparison and repeated actual mechanical uses of a selected alternate substrate. Conditional method candidate, not proof of independent learning, superior judgment, comparative efficiency, general transfer, host-native equivalence or policy promotion.
